candidates.en: Ah... on my travel list, number one, cage diving with great white sharks; number two, hitchhiking across America from New York to San Francisco; number three, touring overland in Africa, and number four is climbing Mount Qomolangma, which, let’s be honest, I need to think twice.
candidates.zh: 我的旅行清单上，第一项是在防护笼里潜水，近距离接触大白鲨；第二项是搭便车横穿美国，从纽约到旧金山；第三项是在非洲进行陆路旅行；第四项是攀登珠穆朗玛峰，不过说实话，这一项我得三思。

candidates.en: Well, firstly, I grew up in an international household with a German mother and an Italian-American father, so our daily lives and conversations always were more global in a lot of ways.
candidates.zh: 首先，我在一个国际化家庭里长大，母亲是德国人，父亲是意大利裔美国人，因此我们的日常生活和交谈，在很多方面都更具全球视野。

因此我们的日常生活和交谈，在很多方面都更具全球视野。

candidates.en: Secondly, when I was 16, I left home to go to the United World College, which is a two-year boarding school with students from 90 different countries.

candidates.en: There, I really grew to see the entire world as an interconnected place, and began to think of myself less with national identities and more through global and human lenses.
